Name: Custom Visual Event Command
Author: jangkup90
Description:
[b][size=5]Custom Visual Event Command[/size][/b]
This is a framework mod for Stardew Valley that allows mod creators to easily add visual flair to their custom events. Whether you want to show a static CG image, a looping character animation, or a massive grid-based sprite sheet, this framework handles the heavy lifting.

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom Event Commands: Introduces /ShowAnim and /StopAnim specifically designed for event scripting.
[*]Sprite-Sheet Animation Support: Animate characters, visual effects, or large CGs by providing a horizontal or grid-based sprite sheet.
[*]GPU-Friendly Grid Layouts: Bypass hardware texture size limits for long animations by reading frames from a 2D grid format.
[*]Pixel-Perfect Auto-Scaling: Automatically calculates the optimal scale to fit the player's screen size while maintaining the original aspect ratio without blurring.
[*]Content Patcher Integration: Seamlessly loads textures from the game's shared asset pipeline, allowing easy integration with Content Patcher.
[/list][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.

[*]Download this mod and extract the CustomVisualEventCommand folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.

[/list][b][size=4]How to Use[/size][/b]
This framework provides easy-to-use commands that you can inject into any event script.

[b]1. Show Image / Animation[/b]
Displays an image or plays a looping animation on the screen. The event script will continue running in the background while the image is displayed.

Syntax:
[code]/ShowAnim [ImageTarget] [TotalFrames] [FrameDelayMs] [Columns][/code]
[list]
[*]ImageTarget (Required): The dictionary key/path to your image in the asset pipeline (e.g., MyModName_HeroSprite). Do not use forward slashes (/) in your target name, use underscores (_) instead.
[*]TotalFrames (Optional): The total number of frames in your sprite-sheet. Defaults to 1 (static image).
[*]FrameDelayMs (Optional): The delay between each animation frame in milliseconds. Defaults to 100.
[*]Columns (Optional): The number of columns in your sprite-sheet grid. If omitted, it defaults to the TotalFrames value (treating the image as a single horizontal row). Highly recommended for animations with many frames.
[/list]Example in Content Patcher:
[code]"9999999/DayEvent": "none/1 1/farmer 1 1 2/ShowAnim MyName_CoolAnimation 60 100 6/pause 5000/StopAnim/end"[/code]

[b]2. Stop Animation[/b]
Removes the currently displayed image or animation from the screen.

Syntax:
[code]/StopAnim[/code]

[b]Console Commands[/b]
You can mock and test your visuals in real-time using the SMAPI console. You must load a save file and be in the game world to use this.

Syntax:
[code]test_anim [ImageTarget] [TotalFrames] [FrameDelayMs] [Columns]
[/code]

Example for a 60-frame grid animation:

[code]test_anim MyName_CoolAnimation 60 100 6[/code]
This will trigger a mock cutscene, display your animation for 5 seconds, and then automatically end the event.
